# SasaVenos Observes That Isometric Skills Like Maltese And Iron Cross Are Isometric Portions Of Full Range Of Motion Skills

SasaVenos observes that isometric holds like maltese, front lever and iron cross are just isometric portions of full range of motion skills such as van gelder, front lever pull and butterfly, and that this is what he believes in. [src: vid-krqBQjUydGY]

## Details

- He says that isometric holds like maltese, front lever and iron cross are just isometric portions of the full range of motion skills such as van gelder, front lever pull and butterfly. [src: vid-krqBQjUydGY]
- He says that isometric skills in calisthenics are just like isometric portions of repetitions in the gym, just a hundred times harder. [src: vid-krqBQjUydGY]
- He says this may seem like total nonsense but this is what he believes in and he devoted his time to learn about it. [src: vid-krqBQjUydGY]
- He says that in calisthenics we are also doing weight training and usually working with pretty heavy loads considering the positions we need to hold that weight in. [src: vid-krqBQjUydGY]
- He says a planche press is a very heavy weight exercise where you need to carry a certain amount of weight through a certain range of motion, the same as bench press, you just need a different kind of strength. [src: vid-krqBQjUydGY]

## Evidence

- vid-krqBQjUydGY (SasaVenos): "isometric holds like maltese front lever and iron cross are just isometric portions of the full range of motion skills such as van gelder front lever pull and butterfly"
